title: Sr. Manager/ AGM – Logistics
description:
**About Company**
 Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e\-Commerce, B2B2C, B2B and B2C organization and an industry leader in print technology, operates in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, and India through its family of brands – Banner Buzz, Covers \& All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media, Neon Earth, Optamark and North cape. From full suites of trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signages and shades to eclectic personal accents and home decor, we help our customers, clients, and partners to make a personalized statement through ,customization.
   

  

 While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1800\+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.
   

  

 For more about Group Bayport, please visit
   

  

**Website:** 
 https://groupbayport.com/about\-us/
   

  

**LinkedIn:** 
 https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/mycompany/
   

  

**Designation:** 
**Sr. Manager/ AGM – Logistics**
**Location: Gandhinagar**
**About The Role**
 This role owns end\-to\-end execution of Bayport's outbound and inbound logistics operation — from raw material import through SEZ export compliance, carrier management, international transit, and final delivery with proof of delivery — while also owning full financial control of the freight and 3PL spend that flows through the department. This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who has run high\-volume international parcel/express operations before and can bring immediate rigor, carrier relationships, and operational and financial discipline to a fast\-scaling, compliance\-intensive environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* International Carrier \& Freight Management: Own the relationship and performance of FedEx, UPS, Emirates and other carrier partners — rate negotiation, annual contracts, service\-level management, escalation handling, and carrier score carding across air, sea, and surface.
* Inbound \& Outbound Logistics: Own inbound raw material import logistics with a focus on cost and lead\-time reduction, alongside full ownership of outbound sea and air shipments across B2B, B2C, and marketplace channels.
* SEZ \& Trade Compliance: Ensure disciplined, audit\-ready execution of shipping bill filing, customs documentation, and SEZ regulatory requirements, with working knowledge of duties, taxes, tariffs, and Importer of Record (IOR) procedures across key markets (US, Canada, UK, Australia, EU, China).
* 3PL Vendor Bill Audit \& Financial Control: Own the checking and audit of all 3PL/carrier vendor bills against contracted rates and actual service delivered and drive timely payment and reconciliation in coordination with Finance and the vendor — this is a named, direct accountability of this role, not a shared or informal responsibility.
* End\-to\-End Operational Ownership: Drive the full flow from production handover through packing, carrier dispatch, in\-transit visibility, destination customs, last\-mile delivery, and signed proof of delivery (POD).
* Team Leadership: Lead and develop the Logistics Manager and the wider team covering domestic/non SEZ vendor operations, SEZ compliance, night operations, MIS/sea freight/refund \& reship, and Atlanta linked shipping — building capability and accountability at every level.
* Performance \& MIS Reporting: Own a KPI\-driven daily/weekly/monthly MIS reporting cadence — cycle time by stage, on\-time pickup/delivery, freight cost, exception and lost\-shipment tracking, and POD closure — with full visibility to the Head of Supply Chain \& Logistics.
* Cost \& Network Optimization: Continuously identify opportunities to reduce cost per shipment, improve carrier mix, and eliminate avoidable delays or rework across the network.
* Business Expansion \& Vendor Development: Identify and onboard logistics partners in new geographies as Bayport's brands expand into new international markets.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Partner closely with Production Planning, Material Planning, and Vendor Management to tighten the handover from production to logistics and resolve root\-cause issues jointly rather than in isolation.
* Exception \& Escalation Ownership: Personally own resolution of high\-impact exceptions — customs hold, lost shipments, delivery disputes — ensuring timely closure and clear communication.
* Marketplace Logistics: Build the roadmap and business case for bringing marketplace last mile fulfilment in\-house


**What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)**
* A fully visible, stage\-wise logistics dashboard covering the complete order lifecycle — inbound through final delivery, not just packing\-to\-carrier\-handover
* A clean, current, reconciled 3PL vendor billing process with no payment disputes or aged discrepancies with Finance
* Measurable improvement in on\-time pickup and on\-time delivery percentages across all three carriers
* A formalized, audit\-ready SEZ and customs compliance process with clear ownership and turnaround times
* A functioning POD/exception closure process with defined liability and resolution timelines
* A stable, accountable, well\-led Logistics team operating on clear KPIs and a regular performance cadence


**Required Experience**
* 10–15 years in international logistics/parcel\-express operations, with substantial experience managing outbound and inbound volume through global carriers
* Prior experience with FedEx, DHL, UPS, or a comparable global express/parcel carrier is strongly preferred — this significantly shortens the learning curve for Bayport's carrier\-heavy, SLA\-driven model
* Demonstrated experience with export/import compliance, customs documentation, duties/tariffs, and ideally SEZ or bonded\-warehouse environments
* Direct experience auditing 3PL/carrier invoices and managing reconciliation with Finance
* Track record of leading and developing operational teams of meaningful size, with a hands\-on, floor present leadership style
* Experience building or owning KPI dashboards and driving performance through data, not just tenure or relationships


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Engineering, or related field; Master's degree or equivalent is a plus
* Six Sigma / Lean or equivalent process\-improvement certification is an advantage


**Key Competencies**
* Operational and financial rigor under time\-sensitive, SLA\-driven conditions
* Strong carrier and vendor negotiation skills, with working knowledge of duties, taxes, tariffs, and IOR procedures across key international markets
* Direct, transparent communication style with the ability to hold a team accountable while developing them
* Proficient in logistics software, MS Office Suite, and ERP systems
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-scaling, still\-formalizing process environment — able to build structure, not just follow it

title: Sr. ETP Engineer & Process Analyst

* Implement Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) strategies.
* Ensure compliance with environmental regulations.
* Maintain water quality standards through quality control measures.
* Lead and mentor a team of ETP operators and technicians.
* Identify and implement sustainability initiatives within the ETP.
* Maintain accurate records and generate reports for management and regulatory authorities.

* Familiarity with environmental regulations and permitting processes.
* Commitment to environmental sustainability.

title: Plant Head
description:
**Position Summary** 




 The Plant Head will be responsible for the overall leadership, management, and operational performance of the manufacturing facilities of Vidya Wires Limited and ALCU Industries Limited. The role encompasses end\-to\-end responsibility for production, quality, maintenance, supply chain coordination, cost optimization, safety, compliance, people management, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure achievement of business objectives.
 



 The incumbent shall drive operational excellence by maximizing productivity, ensuring customer satisfaction, maintaining statutory compliance, and fostering a culture of safety, quality, accountability, and innovation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic Leadership \& Business Planning** 



* Develop and implement plant strategies aligned with the organization's business objectives.
* Prepare annual operating plans, budgets, capacity plans, and production forecasts.
* Drive business growth through process optimization, productivity enhancement, and cost reduction initiatives.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and implement corrective actions to achieve operational targets.
* Support expansion projects, new product development, and technology upgradation initiatives.



**2\. Production \& Operations Management** 



* Oversee end\-to\-end manufacturing operations across all units.
* Ensure adherence to production schedules and customer delivery commitments.
* Optimize machine utilization, manpower productivity, and resource allocation.
* Minimize downtime, rejection, rework, and process losses.
* Ensure effective implementation of production planning and control systems.
* Coordinate with the sales, procurement, stores, and logistics teams for seamless operations.



**3\. Quality Management** 



* Ensure compliance with customer specifications, internal quality standards, and applicable industry requirements.
* Drive quality improvement initiatives to reduce defects and customer complaints.
* Monitor process capability and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Lead internal and external quality audits.
* Ensure compliance with applicable quality management systems such as International Organization for Standardization standards and customer\-specific requirements.



**4\. Maintenance \& Engineering** 



* Ensure preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of all plant equipment and utilities.
* Improve equipment reliability, availability, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
* Lead capital expenditure projects, plant modifications, and equipment installations.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of utilities including power, compressed air, water, and other critical services.
* Drive energy conservation and asset lifecycle management initiatives.



**5\. Supply Chain \& Inventory Management** 



* Coordinate with procurement and stores teams to ensure timely availability of raw materials and consumables.
* Optimize inventory levels and reduce carrying costs.
* Monitor material consumption, yield, and wastage.
* Ensure effective warehouse management and dispatch planning.



**6\. Cost Management \& Profitability** 



* Prepare and manage plant operating budgets.
* Monitor manufacturing costs and implement cost\-control measures.
* Identify opportunities for waste elimination and process improvement.
* Improve overall plant profitability through operational efficiencies.
* Drive value engineering and lean manufacturing initiatives.



**7\. Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE)** 



* Ensure strict compliance with all safety, health, and environmental regulations.
* Promote a zero\-accident culture across all manufacturing facilities.
* Conduct regular safety audits, risk assessments, and emergency preparedness drills.
* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental norms and pollution control requirements.
* Investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.



**8\. Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws, factory regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Liaise with government authorities, auditors, customers, and certification agencies.
* Ensure compliance under the provisions of the applicable laws including:
* Factories Act and applicable state factory rules
* Environment, Health and Safety regulations
* Industrial relations and labour laws
* Fire and electrical safety requirements
* Legal metrology and other industry\-specific regulations



**9\. People Management \& Industrial Relations** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop departmental heads and plant employees.
* Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Drive employee engagement, performance management, and succession planning initiatives.
* Maintain healthy industrial relations and proactively address employee grievances.
* Coordinate with the HR department for manpower planning, training, and workforce development.



**10\. Continuous Improvement** 



* Drive implementation of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, Kaizen, and 5S initiatives.
* Lead digital transformation and automation projects.
* Benchmark plant performance against industry standards.
* Encourage innovation and continuous improvement across functions.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Production achievement against plan
* Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)
* Capacity utilization
* Cost per unit produced
* Rejection and rework percentage
* Customer complaint rate
* On\-time delivery performance
* Machine downtime
* Inventory turnover ratio
* Energy consumption per unit
* Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR)
* Employee attrition and absenteeism rates
* Audit and compliance scores



  





**Educational Qualification** 



* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Production, Industrial, or related discipline).
* MBA in Operations Management is preferred.
* Six Sigma Certification is preferred.



  





**Experience** 



* Minimum 15–20 years of experience in manufacturing operations.
* At least 5–8 years of experience in a senior leadership role as Plant Head, Operations Head, or Manufacturing Head.
* Experience in wire, cable, copper, aluminium, metal processing, or related manufacturing industries is preferred.
* Proven track record in managing multiple manufacturing units.



  





**Required Competencies** 




**Technical Competencies** 



* Production planning and control
* Lean manufacturing and TPM
* Quality management systems
* Cost management and budgeting
* Supply chain management
* Maintenance management
* Industrial engineering
* ERP/MRP systems
* Statutory compliance and factory operations



**Behavioural Competencies** 



* Strategic thinking
* Leadership and team building
* Decision\-making ability
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Communication and negotiation skills
* Change management
* Conflict resolution
* Result orientation
* Stakeholder management

title: Quality Manager
description:
**Quality Manager – MOBA India** 




**Company:** 

 MOBA Mobile Automation India Pvt. Ltd.
 




**Location:** 

 Gandhinagar, Gujarat
 




**Experience:** 

 7\-10 years
 




**Industry:** 

 Off\-Highway Electronics / OEM Supply / Industrial Manufacturing
 




  





**About MOBA India** 





 MOBA India is part of MOBA Mobile Automation AG, Germany, a globally respected brand in the off\-highway electronics and automation industry with nearly 50 years of innovation. The company serves leading OEMs across road construction, mining, agriculture, and aerial work platforms, and in India has grown from a small team in 2004 to a 170\+ member organization serving globally recognized customers such as L\&T, Ammann, Volvo, JCB, CNH, and Atlas Copco.
 




  





**Role Purpose** 





 MOBA India is looking for an experienced Quality Manager to build and lead the quality function from the ground up. This role is not limited to end\-of\-line inspection; it requires establishing a structured Quality Management System, introducing Total Quality Management practices, building quality processes and documentation, leading internal audits, and embedding quality across incoming, in\-process, final inspection, supplier quality, customer quality, and continuous improvement activities in line with standard manufacturing expectations.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**·** 

 Build, implement, and continuously improve the company Quality Management System covering process definition, documentation, control, compliance, and governance.
 




**·** 

 Develop quality foundation documents including SOPs, inspection standards, process maps, quality control plans, check sheets, work instructions, nonconformity handling formats, CAPA systems, deviation control, and controlled records.
 




**·** 

 Move the organization beyond end\-of\-line inspection by introducing incoming quality control, in\-process quality checks, stage\-wise inspection criteria, process audits, and structured quality feedback loops with production and engineering.
 




**·** 

 Deploy practical quality tools such as Control Plan, PFMEA, APQP, PPAP, SPC, MSA, 8D, root cause analysis, and corrective/preventive action systems as relevant to OEM\-facing manufacturing.
 




**·** 

 Lead internal audits, support customer audits, prepare the organization for external certification or compliance reviews, and drive closure of audit findings across functions.
 




**·** 

 Establish quality KPIs such as rejection ppm, first pass yield, rework, supplier defects, field failures, customer complaints, warranty trends, and CAPA closure effectiveness, with regular reporting to management.
 




**·** 

 Work closely with Production, Stores, SCM, Engineering, Service, and Management to ensure quality is built into processes rather than checked only at dispatch.
 




**·** 

 Develop supplier quality practices including supplier qualification support, incoming inspection standards, supplier corrective action, and supplier performance monitoring.
 




**·** 

 Ensure calibration planning, measurement system discipline, traceability, and controlled use of gauges, fixtures, and testing equipment.
 




**·** 

 Build organization\-wide quality awareness through training, documentation discipline, audit readiness, and practical implementation of standard quality practices on the shop floor.
 




  





**Candidate Profile** 




**·** 

 Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, Production, or related engineering discipline; master’s degree preferred.
 




**·** 

 7–10 years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, preferably in industrial electronics, automotive components, off\-highway equipment, or OEM\-facing manufacturing environments.
 




**·** 

 Proven experience in setting up or significantly strengthening a quality system from scratch, not only managing final inspection activities.
 




**·** 

 Strong hands\-on knowledge of ISO 9001 and practical implementation of process\-based QMS in manufacturing.
 




**·** 

 Working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, Control Plan, FMEA, SPC, MSA, CAPA, NCR, 8D, and internal audit systems.
 




**·** 

 Experience in handling customer quality expectations, audit preparation, and closure of nonconformities through cross\-functional coordination.
 




**·** 

 Strong leadership, communication, documentation, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
 




  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




**·** 

 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor qualification in ISO 9001 preferred.
 




**·** 

 Exposure to IATF 16949\-style core tools or similar OEM quality expectations is highly desirable.
 




**·** 

 Experience in electronics assembly, rugged industrial products, or low\-to\-medium volume OEM supply environments is an added advantage.
